blurb: Bobby’s Bike Hike offers kayak rentals to help you explore Chicago’s lakefront on Lake Michigan, departing from Ohio Street Beach. Options include single, tandem, sunset, and family-oriented rentals. Rentals allow paddling at your own pace, enjoying views of the city from the water. Experiences are suitable for outings such as family trips, date nights, or team building.
